# EXP-ECDLP-d68ac9
# Window pair-sum counts. No index search.
# Approved by DEC-20261002-d32486.
experiment:
  id: EXP-ECDLP-d68ac9
  hypothesis_id: H-ECDLP-298630
  source_idea: IDEA-20260913-04fb8c
  question_id: RQ-ECDLP-002
  version: 1
  title: Window pair-sum counts
  status: approved
  frozen: true
  designed_at: '2026-10-02'
  approved_by: coordinator
  approval_decision_id: DEC-20261002-d32486
  objective: >-
    Recompute the two length-8 windows on the prime-order point and
    compare their pair-sum counts with 36.
  inputs:
    p: 151
    A: 1
    Bcurve: 3
    Px: 1
    Py: 55
    order: 167
    j: 72
    residue_1728: 67
    lambda_full: 5
    lambda_short: 23
    mult_order: 166
    window: 8
    ceiling: 36
    short_count: 28
    shortfall: 8
    escape_num: 1
    escape_den: 8
    log_above_num: 421
    log_above_den: 100
    log_below_num: 422
    log_below_den: 100
    sqrt_lo_num: 2828
    sqrt_lo_den: 1000
    sqrt_hi_num: 2829
    sqrt_hi_den: 1000
    sqrt_lo_sq: 7997584
    sqrt_hi_sq: 8003241
    eight_million: 8000000
  controls:
    - >-
      The multiplier 5 meets the ceiling 36. The multiplier 23 has
      28 sums. Reporting 36 for the second window invalidates the
      run.
    - >-
      The shortfall is 8. Reporting another difference invalidates
      the run.
    - >-
      The logarithm of 167/9 is strictly above 4.21 and strictly
      below 4.22. Reporting it as at most 4.21 invalidates the run.
    - >-
      The square 2828 squared is 7997584, below 8 million, and
      2829 squared is 8003241, above 8 million. Reporting sqrt(8)
      as at most 2.828 or at least 2.829 invalidates the run.
    - >-
      The invariant is 72, not 0 and not 67. Reporting either
      special residue invalidates the run.
    - >-
      Both multipliers have order 166, not 83. Reporting 83
      invalidates the run.
    - Two curve routes. They must not import each other.
  independent_variables:
    - multiplier
    - route in {ladder, affine}
  metrics:
    primary:
      - pair_sum_5
      - pair_sum_23
      - log_sides
      - implementations_agree
    secondary:
      - j
      - sqrt_sides
  heuristic_under_test: null
  preregistered_prediction:
    quantity: The pair-sum counts 36 and 28.
    formula: >-
      Multiply the point (1, 55) by the successive powers of the
      multiplier modulo 167. Sum the window points over i less than
      or equal to j. The maximum is C(9, 2) = 36. Compare 167 to the
      100th power with 9 to the 100th times 2 to the 421 and 2 to
      the 422. Compare 2828 squared and 2829 squared with 8 million.
    source: >-
      IDEA-20260913-04fb8c states the curve, the two windows, and
      the counts 36 and 28, read 2026-10-02. The sums were
      recomputed in this design session. That recomputation is not
      a run. No index was searched.
  scale_relevance:
    tier: toy
    justification: One prime field and two windows of length 8. No transfer to a larger group.
    correspondence: null
  tail_checks:
    - The second window is required. Stopping after the count 36 and still reporting the shortfall 8 is invalid.
  replication:
    seeds: []
    independent_instances: 2
    replication_note: Deterministic. The second run is the other curve route.
  budget:
    enforcement: advisory
    wall_clock_seconds_per_run: null
    total_cpu_hours: null
    maximum_memory_gb: 1
    maximum_runs: 2
    maximum_workers: 1
  stopping_rules:
    - Stop after two runs.
    - If the second window is reported as 36, mark the attempt invalid.
    - A crash is incomplete, not a negative result.
  invalidation_rules:
    - Either route imports the other.
    - The second window is reported as 36.
    - The shortfall is reported as a value other than 8.
    - The logarithm is reported as at most 4.21 or at least 4.22.
    - sqrt(8) is reported as at most 2.828 or at least 2.829.
    - The invariant is reported as 0 or as 67.
    - Either multiplier order is reported as 83.
    - An index search is reported.
  success_criterion: >-
    Both runs agree that the point order is 167, the invariant is
    72, both multipliers have order 166, the pair-sum counts are
    36 and 28, the shortfall is 8, the logarithm of 167/9 is
    strictly above 4.21 and strictly below 4.22, and sqrt(8) is
    strictly above 2.828 and strictly below 2.829.
  falsification_criterion: >-
    The runs agree, the first window stays at 36, and any count
    differs from the preregistered table.
  required_artifacts:
    - experiments/EXP-ECDLP-d68ac9/runs/<RUN-ID>/manifest.yaml
    - experiments/EXP-ECDLP-d68ac9/runs/<RUN-ID>/command.txt
    - experiments/EXP-ECDLP-d68ac9/runs/<RUN-ID>/stdout.log
    - experiments/EXP-ECDLP-d68ac9/runs/<RUN-ID>/stderr.log
    - experiments/EXP-ECDLP-d68ac9/runs/<RUN-ID>/raw-result.json
    - experiments/EXP-ECDLP-d68ac9/runs/<RUN-ID>/certificate.yaml
  assigned_to: executor
  out_of_scope:
    - Any index-recovery search, kangaroo, or membership strategy.
    - Any claim that the window beats a square-root walk.
    - A curve of cryptographic size.
    - The CERTBIN pricing design withheld by DEC-20261001-92f749.
